title: Tanzania is a country rich in natural, cultural, historical, and archaeological attractions, boasting stunning landscapes, diverse wildlife, and a variety of ethnic cultures. Key highlights include Lake Victoria, Mount Kilimanjaro, the Serengeti, and the Ngorongoro Crater. Despite its immense tourism potential, Tanzania remains one of the poorest countries, having not fully capitalized on its resources. The tourism industry has been historically underdeveloped, with a significant focus on conservation. Recent efforts, including the National Tourism Policy established in 1991, aim to promote tourism, but the country still lags behind neighbors like Kenya in visitor numbers and tourism revenue.
